name: Chicken Enchilada Rice Bowls
intro_html: All the cozy flavor of chicken enchiladas without the rolling, the frying, or the fuss. Chicken, rice, black beans, and corn get smothered in enchilada sauce and cheddar for a bowl that is big on flavor and shockingly light on fat. Thirty-eight grams of protein, four grams of fat, and about $2.00 a serving (at everyday cost).
ingredients_display: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 3.5 lb raw (1587 g)
Seasoned Black Beans (Great Value): 4 cans, drained (910 g)
Enchilada Sauce (Old El Paso): 2 cans (about 1 3/4 cups) (420 g)
Sweet Whole Kernel Corn (Great Value): 2 cans, drained (420 g)
Fat Free Cheddar (Great Value): about 1 3/4 cups shredded (196 g)
cost_note_html: Real Omaha store prices from our weekly grocery board (2026). They still swing by store and by what is on sale.
cost_closing_html: About $2.00 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a lean, cheesy enchilada bowl that beats the frozen dinner on every count.
shop_smart: Chicken on sale, frozen, is the single best habit for keeping these bowls cheap.
Enchilada sauce comes in mild and hot. Grab whichever your table likes. The macros are the same.
Fat free cheddar adds 9 grams of protein per quarter cup for 45 calories and no fat, which is why it earns its spot in the lean bowls.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice. Three and a half cups dry jasmine with water per the package, then set aside.
Cube the chicken and cook in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 165F inside.
Pour in the enchilada sauce and stir to coat the chicken.
Drain the beans and corn and warm them through.
Combine the rice, saucy chicken, beans, and corn in your big pot and stir. Fold in the shredded cheddar.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. Divide that total by 14 and scoop the exact amount into each container. Every bowl lands near 426 calories and 38 grams of protein at just 4 grams of fat.

head.description: A lean chicken enchilada meal prep with rice, black beans, corn, and cheddar. Fourteen servings at about 426 calories, 38 grams of protein, and only 4 grams of fat for roughly $2.00 each (at everyday cost).
head.keywords: high protein meal prep, cheap meal prep, chicken enchilada bowl, low fat meal prep, budget dinner
recipeIngredient: 3.5 lb raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast
2 cans, drained Sweet Whole Kernel Corn
about 1 3/4 cups shredded Fat Free Cheddar
steps: Cook 3.5 cups dry jasmine rice per the package and set aside.
Cube and cook the chicken until it reaches 165F.
Add the enchilada sauce and stir to coat.
Drain and warm the beans and corn.
Combine rice, chicken, beans, and corn and fold in the cheddar.
Weigh the batch and divide into 14 containers.
